text:
Lina: heads-up, follow-up from the onboarding RFC: we should add a lightweight signature + smoke-fuzz pass to the intake so we catch tokenizer / padding / EOS edgecases early.
Theo: +1. can you sketch what the signature would cover?
Lina: minimal proposal: manifest fields (model_id, tokenizer_hash, vocab_size, max_seq, kv_support=true/false) + a signed checksum of exported artifacts. quick checks: tokenization roundtrip for 50 canonical inputs, and a tiny fuzz harness that injects weird utf8 and long prefix sequences.
Jorge: love the fuzz idea. tradeoff: runtime for onboarding goes up. suggest two gates: fast-signature (cheap) as required, and extended-fuzz as opt-in or gated by traffic / enterprise target.
Lina: exactly. fast-signature should run in <3m. extended-fuzz can be scheduled async and flagged in the onboarding report.
Theo: where to store tokenizer_hash? registry manifest? name collision: different tokenizers can share vocab sizes. hash solves it. Also need to surface tokenizer version in UI.
Jorge: CI integration: fail fast on signature mismatch; for fuzz findings, create a non-blocking ticket and mark the onboarding as "fuzz-warn". Only block if fuzz triggers crash / OOM / wrong EOS behavior.
Lina: pseudocode for token roundtrip check:
```
for inp in canonical_inputs:
  tokens = tokenizer.encode(inp)
  out = tokenizer.decode(tokens)
  assert normalize(out) == normalize(inp)
```
Theo: good. also add a streaming-kv smoke: replay a prefix >512 tokens then append 1 token, ensure kv-cache path executes and logits don't spike error. Many regressions hide in kv fallback.
Jorge: storage: add fields to manifest: tokenizer_hash, smoke_seed_id, fuzz_flags. Bench artifacts should include smoke_seed_id so runs are reproducible.
CI-Bot: NOTE: new manifest fields detected. Validator will enforce token_roundtrip and signature checksum in the fast gate. Extended fuzz runs are scheduled by the onboard pipeline worker.
Lina: ownership: I'll update manifest schema and quick-signature runner. Theo pick the kv-smoke harness?
Theo: will do. Jorge you okay owning fuzz runner + triage workflow?
Jorge: yep. small infra note: keep fuzz corpus small (~500 entries) stratified by seqlen and unicode classes to keep cost bounded.
Lina: timeline: aim for fast gate in one sprint, extended fuzz in next. I'll open a PR for schema change and add a short runbook for triage rules.
Theo: :thumbsup:
Jorge: :shipit:
CI-Bot: ACTIONS: Lina->manifest PR; Theo->kv-smoke; Jorge->fuzz-spike and triage playbook.
